title: Authentication failure after password reset
description: Users cannot log in after resetting their password. Login returns HTTP 500 and the session token is not created.

title: Login page crashes on Safari
description: The login page throws a JavaScript exception and goes blank on Safari 17. Users cannot sign in.

title: Session expires immediately after login
description: Users are logged out within seconds of logging in. The JWT token expiry appears to be set incorrectly.

title: OTP not received during two-factor login
description: Some users never receive the SMS OTP so they cannot complete login.

title: Remember me checkbox does not persist session
description: Selecting remember me has no effect and users must log in again next day.

title: OAuth login with Google returns invalid state error
description: Google sign in fails with invalid state parameter for all users.

title: Password strength meter shows wrong color
description: The strength meter shows green for weak passwords. Cosmetic only.

title: Payment fails with timeout at checkout
description: Checkout requests to the payment gateway time out after 30 seconds and orders are not created.

title: Duplicate charge on card after retry
description: Customers are charged twice when they click pay again after a slow response.

title: Refund status not updated in order history
description: Refunded orders still show as paid in the order history page.

title: Invoice PDF shows wrong tax amount
description: GST is calculated on the discounted price incorrectly in generated invoices.

title: UPI payment option missing on mobile
description: The UPI option does not appear in the payment methods list on Android.

title: Currency symbol misaligned on checkout page
description: The rupee symbol overlaps the amount on small screens.

title: Typo in checkout confirmation message
description: The confirmation says Thank you for you order instead of your order.

title: Submit button misaligned on settings page
description: The save button is shifted to the right and overlaps the footer.

title: Dark mode text unreadable in sidebar
description: Sidebar labels are dark grey on a black background in dark mode.

title: Profile picture not displayed after upload
description: The avatar upload succeeds but the old picture is still shown until refresh.

title: Dropdown menu closes immediately on click
description: The filter dropdown closes as soon as it opens on Firefox.

title: Modal cannot be closed on mobile
description: The close icon on the share modal is not clickable on iPhone.

title: Font size too small on pricing table
description: Pricing table text is 10px and hard to read.

title: Spelling mistake on homepage banner
description: The banner says Wellcome instead of Welcome.

title: Tooltip shows raw HTML tags
description: The help tooltip renders escaped HTML tags instead of formatted text.

title: Database deadlock during order update
description: Concurrent order updates cause deadlocks and transactions are rolled back.

title: Data loss when migrating user table
description: The migration script drops the phone number column values for existing users.

title: Slow query on reports page
description: The monthly report query takes over 40 seconds because of a missing index.

title: Search results return deleted products
description: Products that were deleted still appear in search results.

title: Search autocomplete lags on every keystroke
description: Autocomplete requests fire on every key and the input freezes.

title: Filter by date returns empty results
description: Filtering orders by a date range always returns no results.

title: Sort by price is ascending when descending selected
description: Choosing high to low sorts products low to high.

title: API returns 500 when request body is empty
description: POST /api/orders with an empty body throws an unhandled NullPointerException.

title: API endpoint returns 404 for valid user id
description: GET /api/users/{id} returns 404 for users created after the last deploy.

title: Rate limiter blocks legitimate API clients
description: The API rate limit counts requests per server instead of per client and blocks valid users.

title: JSON response missing created_at field
description: The orders API response no longer includes the created_at timestamp.

title: Email notifications not sent after signup
description: New users do not receive the welcome email. The mail queue shows failed jobs.

title: Push notification opens wrong screen
description: Tapping an order notification opens the home screen instead of the order.

title: SMS alerts sent twice
description: Delivery SMS alerts are sent twice to every customer.

title: Memory leak in background worker
description: The worker process memory grows until it is killed every few hours.

title: Dashboard loads slowly with many projects
description: The dashboard takes 15 seconds to load for accounts with over 100 projects.

title: App freezes when uploading large files
description: The browser tab hangs when uploading files larger than 50MB.

title: High CPU usage on image resize service
description: The image service uses 100 percent CPU during peak hours.

title: XSS vulnerability in comment field
description: Script tags in comments are executed when other users view the page.

title: Unauthorized users can access admin page
description: Users without admin role can open /admin by typing the URL.

title: API keys exposed in frontend bundle
description: Secret keys are visible in the compiled JavaScript bundle.

title: Server crashes after deploy on Friday
description: The production server crashes on startup with a missing environment variable.

title: Docker build fails on CI
description: The CI pipeline fails because the base image tag was removed.

title: Website down for users in Europe
description: The CDN returns 503 for all requests from European regions.

title: Pagination skips items on page two
description: The second page of results skips five items.

title: Export to CSV has wrong column order
description: Exported CSV files have the email and name columns swapped.

title: Language switcher does not translate buttons
description: Switching to Hindi translates labels but not buttons.

title: Chart legend overlaps the chart on small screens
description: The legend covers the bars on screens narrower than 400px.

title: Cart total not updated after removing item
description: Removing an item from the cart does not update the total price.

title: Coupon code applied twice
description: A single coupon can be applied twice to the same order.

title: Order confirmation page shows blank screen
description: After payment the confirmation page is blank but the order is created.

title: Login fails after password change
description: After changing their password users get an error when logging in again.

title: Checkout page crashes on applying gift card
description: Applying a gift card throws an exception and the checkout page crashes.

title: Notification bell count incorrect
description: The unread count shows 0 even when there are new notifications.

title: Search is case sensitive
description: Searching iphone does not return iPhone products.

title: Timezone wrong on order timestamps
description: Order times are shown in UTC instead of the user's local time.

title: Account deletion does not remove user data
description: Deleted accounts still have personal data stored in the database.

title: Broken link in footer
description: The privacy policy link in the footer returns 404.
